adc.note: The Uno R4 board with digital sensors sends engineering units, not volts: value 0 is CO2 in % (GSS SprintIR-R-20, UART, 50 readings/s) and value 1 is flow in L/min (Sensirion SFM3300-250-D, I2C 0x40, +/-250 L/min). The firmware sends 9999 for a sensor that is not answering, which the rail check below turns into '---' and a technical alarm.

co2.label: CO2
co2.note: SprintIR-R-20 reading in % CO2. Gain 1 = the sensor's factory calibration; zero it in room air (CO2ZERO AIR) and a calibration-gas check can trim the gain.

flow.label: Flow
flow.note: SFM3300-250-D reading in L/min, inspiration positive. Gain 1 = the sensor's factory calibration.

pneumo.label: Flow
pneumo.note: The same SFM3300-250-D reading (value 1): this is the channel breaths, tidal volume and minute ventilation are computed from. A 3 L syringe check trims k1.
